key_results: Reactive orbital energy theory (ROET) explains WH stereoselectivity through symmetry-allowed and forbidden orbital crossings; occupied-virtual response controls barriers; applies to electrocyclic, cycloaddition and sigmatropic rearrangements
comments: Energetically grounded alternative to traditional orbital symmetry arguments; good pedagogical value but computational cost of ROET relative to standard FMO analysis not discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: WH-allowed pathways show stabilization of occupied reactive orbital near TS
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; symmetry-allowed crossings lower barrier

hypotheses.hypothesis: WH-forbidden pathways have HOMO-LUMO crossing opposing reaction direction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; electrostatic force increases barrier

title: Composition-engineered Sr1−xBaxTiO3 for high-efficiency dielectric resonator antennas in 5G/6G bands
task: Composition-engineered Sr₁₋ₓBaxTiO₃ for 5G/6G dielectric resonator antennas
key_results: Sr₀.₉Ba₀.₁TiO₃ optimal composition (x=0.1) achieves balanced permittivity, low loss, stable dispersion 1–15 GHz; DRA demonstrates |S₁₁|min≈−25 dB, 2.25–3.25 GHz operation
comments: Practical materials engineering for wireless but comparison limited to FR-4 and TMM4; performance vs. commercial LTCC and fused-silica resonators not provided.

hypotheses.hypothesis: x=0.1 composition balances permittivity, loss, and dispersion stability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; best microwave-dielectric performance at this composition

title: A study on the curves of scaling behavior of fractal cities
task: Characterizing scaling behavior curves in fractal cities
key_results: Scaling behavior curves derived from hierarchical urban fractals; two distinct types identified; autocorrelation functions characterize curve properties
comments: Rigorous mathematical framework for urban fractals but empirical validation on real cities appears limited to analysis rather than prediction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scaling curves originate from hierarchical urban structure
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mathematical derivation provided

hypotheses.hypothesis: 1D spatial autocorrelation reveals curve properties
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; correlation functions characterize fractal extent

title: Heterogeneous optically-detected spin-acoustic resonance in solid-state molecular thin-film
task: Coherent spin manipulation via acoustic waves at room temperature
key_results: Achieved zero-field spin control in pentacene thin films with 10⁵ MHz selectivity; Rabi oscillations observed with frequency scaling as √P
comments: First demonstration of mechanically-driven spin control in molecular systems; integration with SAW resonators is elegant but scalability to large arrays unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Acoustic waves can resonantly drive spin transitions without external magnetic field
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; coherent control achieved at room temperature

title: Enhanced charge-density-wave order and suppressed superconductivity in intercalated bulk NbSe2
task: Engineering competing orders in NbSe₂ via electrochemical intercalation
key_results: CDW transition temperature enhanced to ~130 K; superconductivity suppressed; monolayer-like physics achieved in bulk; distinct spectral dip-hump anomalies
comments: Elegant platform for tuning layered materials but irreversibility of intercalation and cation diffusion may limit practical device applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Layer decoupling and electron doping enhance CDW and suppress Tc
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reproduces exfoliated monolayer phase diagram

title: Interfacial magnetic reconstruction and emergent metallicity in oxide heterostructures
task: Emergent metallicity from interfacial magnetic reconstruction in oxide heterostructures
key_results: SrIrO₃/SrRuO₃ becomes metallic from insulating constituents; ferromagnetism emerges in SrRuO₃ layer; Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction drives magnetic reconstruction
comments: Nice example of interface-driven quantum phase engineering; DM interaction hypothesis needs direct experimental confirmation (e.g., magnon spectroscopy).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interfacial DMI favors FM in SrRuO₃ and collinear AFM in SrIrO₃
hypotheses.result: Supported by first-principles calculations; experimental confirmation pending

title: Generative model for information metamaterial design
task: Generative model for programmable information metamaterial design
key_results: Diffusion model + adapters generate multibit meta-atoms and arrays for beam steering, focusing, holography; holography reaches Gerchberg-Saxton fidelity with 3 orders of magnitude speedup; validated on 1-bit and 3-bit implementations
comments: Promising approach for inverse design scalability but experimental validation limited to single designs; robustness to fabrication tolerances and bandwidth not characterized.

model_io.model: Generative diffusion model with functionality adapters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared diffusion prior transfers across diverse electromagnetic functions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; single model adapts to beam steering, focusing, holography

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative design accelerates hologram synthesis vs. Gerchberg-Saxton
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1000× runtime reduction while maintaining fidelity

title: phase2: full-state vector simulation of quantum time evolution at scale
task: Full-state-vector simulation of quantum time evolution at scale
key_results: phase2 simulator scales to 40 qubits on 512 H100 GPUs using 32 TB memory; 100× speedup via common-suffix Pauli-rotation grouping; empirical Trotter error 100× below rigorous upper bound for ruthenium-ligand active spaces
comments: Impressive engineering achievement enabling practical Hamiltonian simulation; however, limited to Pauli rotations and full-state-vector regime (no error models, MBPT).

model_io.model: Full-state-vector quantum simulator (phase2) on distributed GPU cluster

hypotheses.hypothesis: Common-suffix structure reduces inter-node communication overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2 orders of magnitude speedup for grouped rotations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Empirical Trotter error scales well below analytic upper bounds
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; error >100× below bound for converged active spaces (≤32 qubits)

title: AIME2: toward a unified algebraic theory of explainability via approximate inverse operators
task: Unified algebraic framework for explainable AI via weighted generalized inverses
key_results: AIME2 formulates XAI as inverse problem; unifies LIME, SHAP, Anchors, contextual utility; near-machine-precision equivariance; 0.2% perturbation sensitivity; stable reconstruction
comments: Elegant algebraic unification of disparate XAI methods but practical improvement over existing methods not demonstrated on real datasets or black-box models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: XAI methods reducible to weighted generalized inverse structure
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LIME, SHAP, Anchors interpreted within unified framework

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coordinate equivariance holds under AIME2 formulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; near-machine-precision equivariance verified

title: Encoding multiphase dynamics to predict spatiotemporal evolution via latent-space operators
task: Predicting multiphase flow spatiotemporal evolution via latent-space operators
key_results: MultiOKAN (Kolmogorov-Arnold autoencoder + latent operator) reduces reconstruction error vs. baselines; preserves accuracy under noise and reduced data; two-stage training separates spatial and temporal learning
comments: Systematic comparison useful but limited to three canonical multiphase problems; generalization to industrial-scale bubble and particle systems unclear.

inputs: multiphase PDE solutions (bubble rise, particle deposition, fluidized bed)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Encoder layer width dominates fidelity; operator balance controls accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; systematic ablation studies support findings

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent projection provides noise resilience without loss of accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantial perturbations preserved under latent mapping

title: Epigenetic signatures mark early peripheral human B lineage bifurcation and differential transcriptional profiles in mature populations
task: Identify epigenetic signatures and transcriptional profiles distinguishing early B cell developmental bifurcation pathways
key_results: Accessible chromatin domains discriminate T2Mhi and T2Mlo cells; epigenetic signatures persist through differentiation to naive, memory and marginal zone B cells; transcriptional diversity coupled with epigenetic hallmarks
comments: Multi-omics integration (ATAC-seq, CUT&RUN, RNA-seq, CITE-seq, imaging mass cytometry) provides comprehensive characterization, though causality between epigenetic marks and transcriptional outcomes remains unclear.

inputs: T1, T2Mhi, T2Mlo cells (bulk and single-cell)
T1, T2Mhi, T2Mlo, naive, memory, marginal zone B cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: T2 stage exhibits developmental bifurcation into T2Mhi and T2Mlo trajectories
hypotheses.result: Identified distinct accessible chromatin domains and transcriptional profiles discriminating T2Mhi from T2Mlo cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Epigenetic signatures of T2 bifurcation persist during differentiation into mature B cell subsets
hypotheses.result: Memory and marginal zone B cells retain epigenetic hallmarks of their T2Mlo and T2Mhi precursors respectively
